## Context
Implement the live latency dashboard for monitoring per-endpoint and enforcement point performance in real-time.

## Requirements
- Per-endpoint p95 latency display
- Enforcement point latency monitoring
- Real-time updates
- Target: p95 login ≤ 3 seconds
- Health and latency metrics from Operations tag in OpenAPI

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Per-endpoint p95 latency displayed
- [ ] Enforcement point latency monitored
- [ ] Dashboard updates in real-time
- [ ] p95 login ≤ 3 s verified in lab
